scripts.build: cd vendor/opencode && bun install --frozen-lockfile --filter './packages/opencode' --filter './packages/app' && bun run --cwd packages/opencode build --single
scripts.start: BIN=$(find vendor/opencode/packages/opencode/dist -path '*/bin/opencode' -type f | head -1) && exec "$BIN" serve --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-4096}
